title: Listen to Advice and Accept Instruction

questions.question: Better is a poor man who walks in his integrity than one who is crooked in speech and is a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:1 (ESV): "than one who is crooked in speech and is a fool."

questions.question: Wealth brings many new friends, but a poor man is deserted by his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:4 (ESV): "but a poor man is deserted by his friend."

questions.question: A false witness will not go unpunished, and he who breathes out lies will not what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:5 (ESV): "and he who breathes out lies will not escape."

questions.question: Listen to advice and accept instruction, that you may gain what in the future?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:20 (ESV): "that you may gain wisdom in the future."

questions.question: Many are the plans in the mind of a man, but it is the purpose of the Lord that will what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:21 (ESV): "but it is the purpose of the Lord that will stand."

questions.question: Desire without knowledge is not good, and whoever makes haste with his feet does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:2 (ESV): "and whoever makes haste with his feet misses his way."

questions.question: When a man's folly brings his way to ruin, his heart rages against whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:3 (ESV): "his heart rages against the Lord."

questions.question: Good sense makes one slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:11 (ESV): "and it is his glory to overlook an offense."

questions.question: House and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:14 (ESV): "but a prudent wife is from the Lord."

questions.question: Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord, and he will repay him for his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:17 (ESV): "and he will repay him for his deed."

questions.question: Even a child makes himself known by his acts, by whether his conduct is pure and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:11 (similar theme, often misremembered as 19, but 19 talks about discipline). Actually 19:18 talks about discipline. Let's check 20:11. Wait, 20:11 is "Even a child makes himself known by his acts". This question might be misattributed to 19. Let me check 19. 19:26 is about a son. Let's replace with 19:18: "Discipline your son, for there is hope; do not set your heart on putting him to death."

questions.question: Discipline your son, for there is hope; do not set your heart on putting him to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:18 (ESV): "do not set your heart on putting him to death."

questions.question: A man of great wrath will pay the penalty, for if you deliver him, you will only have to do it how?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:19 (ESV): "for if you deliver him, you will only have to do it again."

questions.question: The fear of the Lord leads to life, and whoever has it rests satisfied; he will not be visited by what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:23 (ESV): "he will not be visited by harm."

questions.question: A foolish son is a ruin to his father, and a wife's quarreling is a continual dripping of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:13 (ESV): "and a wife's quarreling is a continual dripping of rain."

questions.question: Strike a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; reprove a man of understanding, and he will gain what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:25 (ESV): "reprove a man of understanding, and he will gain knowledge."

key_verse_text: Many are the plans in the mind of a man, but it is the purpose of the Lord that will stand.
